notes: The required messy case for the Next.js pack, replacing the unlicensed nextjs-chiarel-6-messy (removed in the same handover under eval/cases/REMOVED.json, D15 exception b). This is the licensed equivalent of the chiarel shape: annuaire-entreprises-data-gouv-fr/site (a French government service, github.com/annuaire-entreprises-data-gouv-fr) is MIT-licensed, and its Next 16 upgrade was a genuine upgrade -> revert saga. PR #2146 'chore(next): upgrades Next to v16' merged 2026-01-12 (next ^15.3.8 -> ^16.1.1, 63 files, read from the package.json diff not the title) and was reverted the next day by #2233 'Revert "chore(next): upgrades Next to v16 (#2146)"' (2026-01-13); the team retried and reverted again twice more (#2279 -> #2286, #2352 -> #2300). So PR #2146 is a real, merged, partial/failed migration that was rolled back, exactly the kind the add-golden-case skill says to keep tagged 'messy'. The planner is scored on PR #2146 (the forward upgrade) against what it actually changed, not on the revert. Router: app/ (app router). Test runners: jest.config.js + cypress at base. Uses package-lock.json, so cases:verify's npm lockfile reader applies. base_commit is the only parent of the merge commit (parents=1).
